rule: DuckDB ROUND(value,3), numeric equality with explicit NULL contract
sql:
WITH fields AS (SELECT unnest(fields) AS r FROM read_json(?))
SELECT count(*) AS value_count,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE ROUND(r.database_qfq,3) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROUND(r.calculated_qfq,3)) AS same_at_three_decimals
FROM fields
